assignment.title: How does a volcano work?
assignment.instructions: Explain how a volcano works in four short paragraphs. Use two facts from the lesson.

sections.label: Introduction
sections.text: A volcano is a mountain that opens like a lid. Hot rock from deep inside the earth comes out.

sections.label: Body
sections.text: Deep under the ground the rock is so hot that it melts and becomes magma. The magma is lighter than the rock around it, so it pushes upward through cracks.

sections.label: Body
sections.text: When the magma reaches the top it is called lava. The lava flows down the sides and cools. After many years the cooled lava makes the mountain taller.

sections.label: Conclusion
sections.text: Volcanoes are dangerous but they also make new land. That is why people still study them today.

improvements: Add one fact from the lesson to show where the hot rock comes from.
